## TRA Timeline

#### Original TRA execution

- 2018-07-31?: Original Tax Receivables Agreement executed between Galaxy Digital Holdings Ltd. (Old GDHI), GDH Intermediate LLC, GDH GP LLC, and certain TRA Limited Partners (85% sharing rate; date taken from later A&R recitals, original instrument not in this directory)

#### Planned redomestication and amendment

- 2022-01-28: S-4 files form-of Amended and Restated TRA as Exhibit 10.3, contemplating a Delaware redomestication paired with a BitGo merger
- 2025-03-27: S-4/A No. 7 refiles a restructured form-of A&R TRA reflecting a domestication-then-merger mechanic; the BitGo combination has been abandoned
- 2025-04-07: 424B3 management circular sets the GDHL shareholder vote for May 9, 2025

#### Redomestication close and parent-role transfer

- 2025-05-13: Reorganization closes; A&R TRA executed under successor Delaware PubCo Galaxy Digital Inc. (CIK 0001859392). GDHL ceases to be the TRA obligor; the in-force contract continues under the successor.

## Explanation

Galaxy Digital Holdings Ltd. was the Cayman Islands PubCo of an Up-C structure that originated a Tax Receivables Agreement dated July 31, 2018, paying 85% of cumulative net realized tax benefits from Section 754 basis step-ups on exchanges of LP units to a pool of TRA Limited Partners. Between January 2022 and March 2025 GDHL filed and repeatedly amended an S-4 registering a redomestication to Delaware; the planned amended-and-restated TRA was filed as a form-of exhibit but not executed under GDHL's CIK. The reorganization closed on May 13, 2025: GDHL domesticated to Delaware as GDHI, GDHI merged into Galaxy Digital Inc. (CIK 0001859392), and the A&R TRA was executed under the successor's CIK. Treated as terminated at the GDHL level because the parent role moved off this CIK; the same economic TRA continues under the successor. See `contract_log.md` for the form-of comparison and `../galaxy-digital-inc_0001859392/galaxy-digital-inc_TRA-2025-05-13_summary.qmd` for the successor's record.
